header: 3Boosting Multimodal Perception by Learning to Connect Visual Evidence

images.caption: Figure 2:Overview of our multi-region question synthesis pipeline. We select related regions from a single image and construct a privileged crop view to generate compositional questions. The illustrative example connects a flight number on a boarding pass to its departure gate and then to a service icon (T218→\rightarrowC6→\rightarrowplug). Cross-model answer anchoring and drop-one region tests assess answer reliability and evidence dependence, followed by multiple-choice conversion and difficulty filtering. During training, the policy receives the full image with region outlines, while privileged crops are used only for data construction.
